purpose: Teach: 寸法/鉢/悩ま/こぼし/とかし/しり/ふる/低かっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しいスカート、寸法、ぴったりで嬉しい。
lines.en: Aoi, I love how perfectly the new skirt fits.
lines.style: Warm and immediate, gentle brightness in the opening. A small, genuine compliment delivered without performance. Soft eye contact.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。観葉植物の鉢、もう一個、欲しいなと思って。
lines.en: Yeah. I've been thinking I want to get another pot for the plants.
lines.style: Soft, slightly dreamy. A small shift away—not evasion, just a mind gently landing somewhere else. Quiet agreement before the turn.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 彼の浮気疑惑、私を悩ますばっかり、最近。
lines.en: Lately his doubts about cheating just keep weighing on me.
lines.style: Vulnerability surfacing carefully. The admission comes out on a lower note, fragile but honest. Pause before the word 'cheating.' Not performed pain—real.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: コーヒー、テーブルに、こぼしちゃった、ごめんね。
lines.en: Oh, sorry—I spilled some coffee on the table.
lines.style: Quick, slightly self-conscious. A brief apology that lands lighter than it could. The moment passes quickly because she doesn't dwell in it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。前髪、お店でとかしてもらったの、爽快よ。
lines.en: Yeah. Getting my bangs trimmed at the salon today was really refreshing.
lines.style: A lighter note, genuine brightness returning. The relief of a small change that mattered. Open, almost relieved tone on 'refreshing.'

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 子供の頃、しりとり、よくやったね、姉妹で。
lines.en: You know, we used to play shiritori all the time as kids, didn't we?
lines.style: Wistful, looking backward gently. The memory arrives softly, not urgent. A tender recognition of something shared and past. Slight trailing softness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今日、雨がふる予報だったのに、晴れたよね。
lines.en: Today was supposed to rain but look—it cleared right up.
lines.style: A small observational brightness. Simple pleasure in a small surprise. Light, easy, almost conversational—noticing something small that went right.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 去年の客足、確かに、低かったよね、ここ。
lines.en: Yeah, the customer traffic really did drop off last year, didn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, measured. An honest acknowledgment without heaviness. Calm recognition of something difficult but accepted. Trailing close, like a quiet end.
